messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@pearsonhotels.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quiet-room amenity requests, late shuttle ops, and billing routing for Nov 16–18 workshop

Hi Oliver / Sara —

Thanks again for holding space for our executive workshop the week of Nov 16. A couple of operational asks from the Redwood side so we can finalize the room block and bill routing:

- Quiet-room subset (12 rooms): we need rooms flagged for low noise (interior-facing, away from HVAC stacks). Please confirm which room numbers you can guarantee.
- In-room amenities: request for 6 white-noise units, 8 large-desks (standing desk option where possible), and universal adapter kits in all exec rooms.
- Dietary / late-night snacks: attendees will arrive late on Tue evening; can the kitchen hold a small snack drop until 10:30pm? Contact for catering below.
- Shuttle window: last shuttle from venue to airport needs to run at 12:30am Tue–Wed and 1:00am Wed–Thu. Please confirm driver availability and incremental cost.
- Billing: we want consolidated invoicing under Redwood PO 64521 (we will share PO). Need a proforma showing taxes and incidental holds per room.

Attachments: I uploaded our attendee preference sheet to the shared folder.

Can you return a brief rate addendum and a list of room numbers you propose for the quiet subset by EOD Tue? We need to route the contract to procurement on Wed.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference platform

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, CateringOps <catering@venuecater.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet-room amenity requests, late shuttle ops, and billing routing for Nov 16–18 workshop

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the clear list. I've attached our preliminary rate proposal and a room map with candidate quiet rooms marked (attachment: Pearson_RateProposal_Nov2026.pdf). Quick answers below: 

- Quiet subset: we can hold interior rooms 312–323 and 412–420 for your 12 quiet rooms. We recommend 312–323 as they’re furthest from the service elevator.
- White-noise units & desks: we can supply 6 white-noise units and 8 large desks (lift desks in 6 rooms) for a one-time setup fee of $420.
- Adapter kits: available at $9/kit; we can pre-stock rooms.
- Late-night snacks: kitchen can do a boxed snack run until 10:30pm for no additional charge, after hours incurs a $125 labor fee.
- Shuttle: drivers available for the late windows requested; estimated incremental cost is $185 per late run (one-way). We can consolidate rides if attendee lists are stable.
- Billing & PO: we will produce a proforma that includes tax and incidental hold ($75/room). Please send PO 64521 to billing@pearsonhotels.com.

Next steps: I’ll revise the room block addendum and send for signature once you confirm the quiet-room set and the shuttle cadence.

Regards,
Oliver Hayes
Director, Sales — Pearson Hotels
oliver.hayes@pearsonhotels.com | +1 206-555-8890

Attachment: Pearson_RateProposal_Nov2026.pdf

Thanks Oliver — this looks good. Two quick procurement items from our side: 

1) Please include the incidental hold line-item and a pre-authorization cap amount on the proforma. Our finance team requires the cap to be visible before PO release.
2) We will sign the room-block addendum but need the final document to be routed via DocuSign (no PDFs emailed for signature). Please confirm you can send a DocuSign link.

Also: Jonas — can you pull the attendee list and mark who needs a lift desk vs. standard desk? I’ll reconcile with the adapter kit counts.

Marissa Cole

Marissa / Olga —

Thanks — we can absolutely do DocuSign. I’ve updated the addendum to show the incidental hold cap at $75/room and included a separate pre-auth contingency line. DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/relink/ABC123-roomblock

I also attached the revised addendum that reflects: quiet rooms 312–323 confirmed, 6 white-noise units, 8 lift desks, 20 adapter kits reserved, late runs at $185 per one-way, and kitchen hold until 10:30pm (after-hours labor shown separately).

Please route PO 64521 to billing@pearsonhotels.com and let me know when the DocuSign completes — we will release the room hold upon receipt of the signed addendum.

Oliver
